paragraphs: Nimos the weaver asked R. Meir, Ḥagigah 15b. Shemot Rabbah, beginning of Bo: he asked the sages and went to Abba Yosef the builder. Eikhah's proem says no philosophers arose for the nations like Bilam and Avnimos the weaver; likewise Bereshit Rabbah, Toledot 65. How could the preceding Nimos, R. Yehoshua HaGirsi's brother, bear a gentile's name? Perhaps it should read Avgimos, with gimel. His mother died and R. Meir went to pay him a condolence visit, Ruth Rabbah.
